description: This file defines the FreeMarkerViewHandler class, which manages rendering FreeMarker templates within the OFBiz web application framework. It includes methods for initializing the handler, rendering templates, and preparing the data model with OFBiz-specific objects.

classes.name: FreeMarkerViewHandler
classes.description: A view handler for rendering FreeMarker templates in the OFBiz framework, extending AbstractViewHandler.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the template configuration with the servlet context, setting cache storage and template loading path.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a specified FreeMarker template with the provided context, handling different template source formats and exceptions.

methods.name: prepOfbizRoot
methods.description: Prepares the data model for FreeMarker templates by injecting OFBiz-specific objects such as delegator, dispatcher, security, userLogin, and request/response/session objects.
